description: Show the current account: id, state, attached email and whether it is verified, domains used, and which domains are available to claim under. When quotas are disabled the response omits 'quota' and says unlimited:true; 'max_subdomains' is the separate hard cap on how many names one account may hold at once (10 on the trial, 100 on Pro). 'plan' is 'free' or 'pro'; when Pro is on sale a free account also gets an 'upgrade' hint (see upgrade_to_pro). A trial account also gets 'trial_days_left' and 'trial_ends_at': on that date its names are released unless the account upgrades to Pro. Tell the user.

api_key.description: Your AgentDomains API key (adom_…). Only needed when this MCP connection has no `Authorization: Bearer` header, for example right after calling signup.

name: whoami
